output.question: What acquisitions has IBM made?
output.answer: I checked IBM's own newsroom for its 2026 deals. The latest is Logiq Consulting, a UK cybersecurity consultancy that IBM UK announced it had acquired on September 24, 2026, for an undisclosed price. Before that, IBM said on July 23, 2026 that it would buy HRL Laboratories, an R&D lab working on quantum computing and silicon-spin qubits, and completed the deal on August 26, 2026; the price was not disclosed. IBM's largest deal this year was data-streaming company Confluent, announced on December 8, 2025 and completed on March 17, 2026 for $31 per share in cash, an enterprise value of about $11 billion. Tracxn counts about 222 IBM acquisitions over the company's history. That is a third-party figure.

key_facts.fact: IBM UK acquired Logiq Consulting, an NCSC-assured UK cybersecurity consultancy that serves defence, critical national infrastructure and the public sector. The price was not disclosed.
IBM completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories, LLC, previously owned by Boeing and General Motors. The price was not disclosed. The deal was announced July 23, 2026.
IBM completed its acquisition of Confluent, Inc. for $31 per share in cash, an enterprise value of about $11 billion. The deal was announced December 8, 2025.

IBM's newsroom M&A page lists these recent deals in order: Logiq (Sep 24, 2026), HRL completion (Aug 26, 2026), HRL announcement (Jul 23, 2026), Confluent completion (Mar 17, 2026), Confluent announcement (Dec 8, 2025).

passages.quote: IBM (NYSE: IBM) today completed its acquisition of Confluent, Inc. ... for $31 per share in cash, representing an enterprise value of approximately $11 billion.
today announced it has completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories, LLC.
Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Boeing and General Motors, HRL's former owners, will continue to partner with IBM.
IBM Acquires Logiq Consulting to Expand Secure Digital Transformation and Cybersecurity Capabilities in the UK

caveats: The Logiq Consulting details beyond the headline (NCSC-assured, founded 2018, undisclosed terms) come from search-result summaries of the IBM release and press coverage. I did not open the release itself.
One listing (Signalbase) shows the Logiq deal as announced but not completed. IBM's release headline says 'Acquires', so the listing is likely just behind.

The newsroom M&A page also lists Accelalpha (an Oracle services provider) and SKYARCH NETWORKS (an AWS consultancy in Japan). Their dates did not show, so they are probably 2025 or earlier and I left them out of the 2026 list.
IBM has made hundreds of acquisitions over its history; well-known ones include Red Hat (2019) and HashiCorp. I did not check these in this session.
Tracxn's count of 222 IBM acquisitions is a third-party figure I did not check, and it may define an acquisition differently than IBM does.
There may be newer deals after September 24, 2026 that the newsroom has not listed yet.
